name: Battle_Ui_UpdateMessageSequence
signature: u32 Battle_Ui_UpdateMessageSequence(BattleUi* self, MessageCtx* ctx, ActorView* view, int actorIndex)
summary: Battle-UI state machine keyed on the acting row (self[0x497] action record): advances a message/animation sequence, pushes battle-message entries, spawns popups and balloons and plays sound effects as each row state finishes.
evidence: Re-read the whole 1200-line body: every branch dispatches on the self[0x4A5] state ids 0x1DB..0x458 and feeds named battle-UI callees - Battle_MessageQueue_PushEntry (12 calls), Battle_Message_BuildActorRowBig, Battle_Ui_ShowActionEffectMessage, Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnForActorList/NumberList/CountBalloon and Sound_PlaySeById. There is no readable caller and no proven vtable registration yet, but the state machine's role matches the name.

name: Battle_Ui_UpdateMemberActionDisplay
summary: Refreshes the battle member display: scans the eight 0x2C-stride member records for state 6, then per member updates row visibility, spawns name/number popups and queues battle messages for the current action.
evidence: Called by three confident functions - Battle_ActionSequence_Update_2 (0x004F7320), Battle_Sequence_Update (0x005A407C) and Battle_Ui_MemberScreen_Update (0x005940A4) - and the body is exactly a member-row display refresh (Text_IsRowVisible, maybe_Battle_SpawnActorNamePopup, Ui_PopupEntry_*).

name: maybe_Actor2D_PlayAnimOnParts
summary: Three-state animation step for a 2D actor: waits out f_298+0x14, plays the shared anim id from func_00590504(1) on the two child lists, then plays anim 2 and restarts the clip after the retarget timer.
evidence: All callers are unnamed and the body still has unaff_/halt_baddata damage; named callees Anim_PlayByIdForActor and Sound_PlaySeById only confirm that it is an animation step, not which class owns it. Kept as maybe_.

name: maybe_Ui_List_BuildRowsB
signature: u32 maybe_Ui_List_BuildRowsB(u32 self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: Body is 2.2 KB of overlapping Thumb instructions; its callee set matches the 0x0030B120 resource loader (Fs_NamedObject_LoadSimple, Pack_HandlePair_MoveAssign/Pack_ReleaseHandle), so it is not a list row builder.
evidence: No named caller; the body carries 'instruction overlaps 0x0030B1C0' warnings and unaff_ registers. The name remains a placeholder, so confidence stays below 0.5.

name: maybe_Model_RandomizeEquipSlots
signature: u16 maybe_Model_RandomizeEquipSlots(Model* self, u32 request, int variant)
summary: For each of four entry ids, rolls a random value between the record's two bounds into self[id+0x49] and equips the selected item into a category slot (Party_EquipItemIntoCategorySlot); then calls the vtable hooks at 0x160/0x164/0x168.
evidence: The body does not select a model id: it rolls via the battle RNG and calls the confident Party_EquipItemIntoCategorySlot four times, so the old name was misleading. The owning class is still unnamed, so the replacement keeps maybe_.

name: maybe_PartyPanel_UpdateHighlight
summary: Updates one shop/party slot panel: advances its animation state, plays SE 5 or starts cue 0x39 at state 0x28, and when the item id changes refreshes the payout gauge and icon through Item_LookupRecord.
evidence: Callees Item_LookupRecord, Ui_SlotWindow_SetupPayoutGauge and Ui_Slot_BindControl are named, but no confident caller names the panel class; kept as maybe_.

name: maybe_Ui_SakusenWindow_UpdateEx
summary: Secondary per-frame update of the tactics (sakusen) window while its detail is open: ticks the layout animation pair at +0x1140/+0x160, then advances the command queue and pushes the detail pane once the prompt confirms.
evidence: Body calls confident Ui_Widget_Update and Ui_SakusenWindow_PushPane with fields from the static block at 0x0072A600, but there is no named caller and 0x0072A600 is not a proven dispatch table - the earlier claim about a '0x0072A698 dispatch table' was wrong. Kept as maybe_.

name: Field_Marker_ExecuteAction
summary: Runs a field marker's interaction: aborts with gadget command 0xC when the game is not in field mode 5, plays action sequence 0x0E on the player with the marker's position block, or (record f_FC == 3) plays SE 0x9D and switches the marker to state 1.
evidence: The body is a complete two-branch interaction handoff built from the named callees Actor_TryPlayActionSeq0E, Field_Gadget_AddAndTriggerCommand and Sound_PlaySeById, and the field-mode test uses work+8 -> +0x48 -> +0x281 exactly as FACTS.md describes.

name: maybe_Ui_GuideWindow_ChangePage
summary: Page-change handler of the guide window: advances the page counter and pushes the page-number message. The decompiled body is partly destroyed (unaff_r6/r7, halt_baddata, an overlapping battle-row loop), so only the page-change role is trustworthy.
evidence: The only named caller is Ui_GuideWindow_UpdateState (0x0036A36C); the body still contains halt_baddata/coprocessor damage, so confidence stays at 0.30.

name: Battle_PlayPartyMemberSe
summary: Updates the eight battle party-member slots: either re-binds each slot's model animations and plays the member SE at f_18, or walks the four formation lists, clears the per-unit marker byte and plays the SE at f_16.
evidence: Called by the confident Battle_UnitModel_AdvanceAnimSequence (0x00429C0C) and Battle_ActionSequence_ConsumeItem (0x004F5858); the body walks 8 slots of stride 0x1C and uses the named Container_List_CollectVisibleIds and Sound_PlaySeById. The name covers the SE half, the summary records the animation/flag half too.

name: Battle_Unit_AttachToColumn
signature: int Battle_Unit_AttachToColumn(void* self, int column, unsigned slot, unsigned entry, unsigned flags, int immediate)
summary: Attaches a resolved battle unit to a battle column: picks the 3D (+0x4330) or 2D (+0x47A0) scene by work+0x4244, resolves the unit from list+0x428C+column*0x1C, rejects when the party would exceed 8 members, then binds it through the scene helpers or plays SE 0x15B.
evidence: The body operates on battle work (mode byte 0x4244, unit lists at 0x428C, scene tables 0x4330/0x47A0), not on a menu window, so the old 'Menu_AttachActorToWindow' named the wrong subsystem. There is no named caller, hence 0.55.

name: Actor_MoveToLocatorAndPlaySe
summary: Two-phase actor move to a locator: phase 0 computes the motion-curve point toward f_30, sets the position and quaternion, plays SE 0xF7 and stores the result in f_4C; phase 1 waits for the locator and then starts the idle animation.
evidence: The body matches the name end to end - Math_Curve_EvaluatePoint, maybe_Gfx_Actor_SetPosition3D, Gfx_Actor_SetPositionXY, Sound_PlaySeById(0xF7) and Actor_TrySelectIdleAnimation - so the role is supported; only the owning actor class is inferred.

name: Ui_NineLineTextWindow_PlayOpenEffect
summary: Plays the 'Open_Back' animation on the window, spawns 2D effect 0x504 at the window position through the effect manager, then plays SE 0xE4B on the lazily created shared anim-sequence object.
evidence: The string literal s_Open_Back_00408924 is passed to vtable +0x84 (animation player) and effect id 0x504 goes to the confident Effect_FindOrCreateInstance, matching the whole name. The nine-line window class still comes from the vtable family only.

name: maybe_Battle_Unit_UpdateActionState
signature: u32 maybe_Battle_Unit_UpdateActionState(BattleUnitView* view, BattleUnit* unit, int* faceData, u32 flags)
summary: Per-frame update of a battle unit's model view: ticks the animation channels and motion state and, when the animation finishes, resolves the unit's face/expression row and plays its recorded SE (special id 0x1EA also fires 0x00421C80).
evidence: Named callees Anim_UpdateChannels, Model_UpdateMotionState and Sound_PlaySeById confirm the per-frame view update, but 'action state' (f_274) is still an interpretation; kept as maybe_.

name: maybe_Ui_OverlaySlot_BeginStateTransition
summary: Starts the overlay slot's exit/move transition from state 0x0B: activates or deactivates its children, places the slot at the player object position, spawns the transition effect and pushes the sound command.
evidence: Callees Field_Object_ActivateChildren, Field_SceneNode_PlayAnimation and Sound_CommandQueue_Push_2 are named, but the slot class and the transition numbering remain inferred; kept as maybe_.

name: maybe_Ui_StartIntroModelSequence
summary: Starts a scripted model sequence for a UI screen: creates the 0x1EB0 model/effect helper with id 0x15, binds the screen model, sets the UI mode word and copies the current view rectangle.
evidence: No confident caller; the body calls Ui_GetCore and Ui_SlotTable_BuildEntriesFromRecords, but the screen class is not proven; kept as maybe_.

name: maybe_PartyPanel_EnsureSlotObjects
summary: Lazily creates the party panel's shared 0x1EB0 helper object, then refreshes the panel: rebuilds the animation sequence, re-binds the slot controls and updates the panel's BGM request.
evidence: Callers are only other maybe_PartyPanel_* functions; callees Anim_Sequence_CtorBase, Ui_Slot_BindControl and Snd_RequestBgmPlay are named, but the panel class and 'EnsureSlotObjects' remain inferred.

name: maybe_Field_TalkBalloon_OpenMessage
signature: int maybe_Field_TalkBalloon_OpenMessage(TalkBalloon* self, int speaker, int style, int owner)
summary: Talk-balloon message start: if the balloon's f_62 flag is set it plays SE 9, then invokes the script TrgBookIDCommand on the event state (+0x6C) with the balloon's speaker byte f_61 and character byte f_60.

name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_UpdateFrame
summary: Per-frame refresh of a message-style window: notifies the layout child, runs Ui_MessageText_Update, resolves the pending text id f_131 through the text-sequence manager into f_134 and starts the fade/row transition when f_D6C and f_D70 differ.
evidence: Callee Ui_MessageText_Update is named, but the window class and the fade meaning remain inferred; kept as maybe_.

name: maybe_Field_TalkBalloon_OpenSimpleMessage
signature: int maybe_Field_TalkBalloon_OpenSimpleMessage(TalkBalloon* self, int speaker, int style, int owner)

evidence: Companion of 0x003D9484; the named callee Event_OnTriggerCommand is clear, but no caller proves which balloon variant this is; kept as maybe_.

name: Field_Actor_TriggerMapJumpEvent
summary: When the field actor's f_289 flag is set and the command manager is free, plays SE 0x52 and calls Script_Native_ATrgMapJumpEvent(ctx, f_280, f_282, 1); returns 1 while the manager is busy.
evidence: The body calls the now-named Script_Native_ATrgMapJumpEvent and Sound_PlaySeById(0x52); the old 'RaiseMarkerEvent' hid which script event was raised. The actor is not proven to be an NPC, so 'Field_Actor_' replaces 'Field_Npc_'.

name: maybe_Ui_OverlaySlot_HandleCommandEnd
summary: Completes an overlay-slot command: for command 4 it deactivates the slot, repositions it at the player, advances the actor state and allocates the transition effect, then switches to state 8; other commands fall back to state 6.
evidence: Companion of 0x0061A948 with the same named callees, but no caller or vtable names the slot class; kept as maybe_.

name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_UpdateMovement
signature: void maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_UpdateMovement(MessageWindow * self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: Per-frame message-window tick: with no active move object it commits the queued BGM/voice id, updates the glyph transforms and text callback and clears the eight sub-widget states; while a move object at +0x6B8 is active it drives and releases it.
evidence: The body is mostly the window move-object lifecycle (Snd_CommitPendingBgmId plus maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_ApplyPlacementTransform), and the plain name Ui_MessageWindow_Update already belongs to 0x001C40F8, so a qualifier is needed. Still no caller, hence maybe_.

name: maybe_Ui_PageControl_UpdateLayout
summary: Rebuilds a paged widget's page table: allocates one 0x98-byte UI object per page and drives both directions of each page's animation controller, then plays SE 0x89. Ghidra lost most argument registers, so the page count and layout maths are unreliable.
evidence: The body has unaff_r4..r10 damage and no caller; kept at 0.30.

name: Ui_MessagePanel_HideOrShowByFlag
summary: Shows or hides a pane of the message panel from the byte at self+4: mode 0 runs the pane's show slots (+0x54/+0x3C) with command 4; any other mode runs the hide slots (+0x58/+0x40) and plays SE 0x102.
evidence: The body is a clean two-way virtual-slot selection with the named Field_SceneNode_CheckActiveFlag and Sound_PlaySeById(0x102); only the panel class is inferred.

name: maybe_Ui_Part_PlaySe50WhenThrottled
summary: Timed part update hook: forwards to the child object (vtable +0x2C) and, while latch f_1C4 is set, timer predicate 0x00649BFC is true and f_18C exceeds 8.0, plays SE 0x32 once and clears the latch.
evidence: The SE id and the 8.0f threshold are literal, but no caller settles the part class or the 'throttled' meaning; kept as maybe_.

name: maybe_Ui_SakusenWindow_CancelIfIdle
summary: Cancels a pending window command when bit 8 of the shared cancel-flag object is clear: calls 0x001DAC7C on self+0x1140 and marks game-work byte +7.
evidence: The only reference is a registration-table entry (0x72A6C8) - there is no named caller, and the earlier claim that this sits in a proven 0x0072A698 dispatch table was wrong. SakusenWindow and 'if idle' remain inferred; kept as maybe_.

name: maybe_Ui_SetValueAndPlaySe11
summary: Mechanical helper: requests SE 0x0B through the sound command queue and copies the two dwords of the global result block at 0x0036A144 into self+8 and self+0xC.
evidence: No caller and no class context; kept as maybe_.

name: maybe_Anim_Timeline_IsIdActive
summary: Looks id up in the data-manager 0x0063E340 table (column selected by self+8) and returns whether the resulting index (< 0xA5) has its bit set in the 0xA5-bit mask at self+0xE0. The table's identity is not proven.
evidence: Called by the confident Ui_Span_IsIdle (0x00641960) and the bitmask test is clear, but 'Anim_Timeline' is an assumption - the id-to-record lookup is byte-identical to the sound/BGM row lookup; kept as maybe_.

name: maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawFogPass
signature: void maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawFogPass(Gfx_ModelInstance* self, int cmdList, unsigned arg3, int* state, int* mode)
summary: Model draw pass gated by material byte f_119: chains the texture-matrix pass with the extra state command and emits all parts.

name: maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawMultiStatePass
signature: void maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawMultiStatePass(Gfx_ModelInstance* self, int cmdList, unsigned arg3, int* state, int* mode)
summary: Model draw pass gated by material float f_1B8: combines the texture-matrix pass with its own state block and per-part texture matrices, then emits the parts.
evidence: Dispatched by Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawPassDispatcher; 'multi-state' describes the extra state block but the material feature is unidentified; kept as maybe_.

name: maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawOverrideMaterialPass
signature: void maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawOverrideMaterialPass(Gfx_ModelInstance* instance, int cmdList, unsigned arg3, int* override, int* mode)
summary: Draws a model instance with an override material: installs that material's GX state and emits every part through the shared part emitter.
evidence: Called by Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawAllPasses, Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawPassDispatcher and maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawOverridePass; the body has instruction-overlap damage at 0x00569E34, so it stays at 0.45.

name: maybe_Ui_SpritePart_Update
summary: Per-frame fade/timer update of a UI sprite part: re-resolves the sprite when its name changed, counts down the blink timer, fades f_24 toward -1 and hides the owner's button / clears the UI list when done.
evidence: Callees Ui_Sprite_DrawByName and Container_IntrusiveList_ClearAll are named, but no caller settles the part class; kept as maybe_.

name: Field_ActorAction_UpdateModelRotation
summary: Smoothly turns the action's scene object toward its target yaw: rate from f_2C/(f_34*dt), clamped and blended into f_30, then writes the resulting matrix into model+0x5F4 (and the optional model+0x160 node).
evidence: Called by the confident Field_ActorAction_Update (0x00372F28) and Field_ActorAction_TurnTowardTarget (0x004137D0); the body contains no camera object, so the earlier Camera_* guess was wrong.

name: maybe_Ui_DungeonHpWindow_LayoutRows
signature: void maybe_Ui_DungeonHpWindow_LayoutRows(UiDungeonHpWindow* self, float* out, int count, u32 arg4, int arg5)
summary: Computes the eased row/bar layout of the dungeon HP window: distributes the bars over the eight slots and writes the float positions into the output array.
evidence: Called by maybe_Ui_DungeonHpWindow_AnimateRows (0x003D50A8); the window class remains positional; kept as maybe_.

name: maybe_Camera_ComputeAngleFromReference
summary: Computes the unsigned angle between the camera forward vector and the global reference axis 0x007E7030: clamped acos, sign from the cross term, degrees via fmod 360 into self+0x11C, plus two rotated reference vectors.
evidence: The only caller is maybe_Field_ObjectSprite_UpdateOwner; the maths is clear but the camera class is inferred; kept as maybe_.

name: Math_RebuildBasis
summary: Rebuilds a stored rotation basis: takes the two existing axes, builds the third by cross product, applies the angle pair at basis[6]/basis[7] and renormalises, writing a valid first axis back into basis[0..2].
evidence: Called by the confident Gfx_EffectPart_UpdateTransform (0x005F7A10) and by Field_ActorAction_UpdateModelRotation; all three callers convert the repaired block to a matrix immediately afterwards (func_00573144).

name: maybe_Field_Action_ToggleRun
summary: Toggles the field action's run state: initialises horse parameters, loads five preset floats into self+0x3C..+0x4C, compares actor f_278/f_27C against the preset and either runs func_003027C0 or calls Field_Action_SetRunState, then swaps the two actor speed presets.
evidence: Callees Field_Action_InitHorseParams and Field_Action_SetRunState are named, but there is no caller and the run/walk meaning of the presets is inferred; kept as maybe_.

name: maybe_Field_Action_StopMoveEffect
summary: Stops the in-flight movement effect and clears the run flag, restoring the actor's animation speed unless the caller asked to keep it.
evidence: It releases attached effect handles (Effect_ReleaseHandle, Sound_Emitter_ReleaseEffect), but the owning action class remains unnamed; kept as maybe_.

name: maybe_Ui_SlotTable_ApplyEntry
summary: Applies the selected slot entry to the message text object: stores the character id, sets the sprite anim unless mode 2, copies the colour byte and resets the entry colour.
evidence: The body is small and clean but only maybe_ slot helpers reference it; the class and text-object link remain inferred; kept at 0.30.

name: maybe_Ui_SlotTable_RefreshForSpeaker
summary: Refreshes the slot table for the current speaker: derives the speaker id, rolls the random entries, then finds the slot matching the active map record and selects/applies it (falling back to the stored selection).
evidence: Callees Ui_SlotTable_RollRandomEntries and Ui_SlotTable_GetSelectedId are named, but there is no caller and the table class remains inferred; kept as maybe_.

name: Ui_BattleWindow_ApplyLayoutMode
summary: Applies the battle arc layout mode from battle work +0x4202: stores the mode byte, seeds the angle/velocity constants, re-arranges the rows on the arc and clears the two unit-list float parameters at +0x4254/+0x4270.
evidence: It reads the battle mode byte +0x4202 and calls the confident Ui_ArcListWindow_ArrangeRowsOnArc and Battle_UnitList_SetActorsFloatParam on the battle unit lists, so only the concrete window class is inferred.

name: maybe_Model_SecondaryMotion_BuildChains
signature: u32 maybe_Model_SecondaryMotion_BuildChains(void* self, u32 allocTag, void* model)
summary: Rebuilds a model's secondary-motion chains: clears old buffers, walks model->f_28 nodes and their 6-byte attribute names, classifies them against table 0x0072F49C (kinds 0..6), then allocates and constructs the chain entries. Returns 0 on an inconsistent attribute set.
evidence: Callees Model_SecondaryMotion_Clear, Mem_AllocAligned and std_ConstructArray are named; the 5.5 KB body and chain layout are only partly decoded; kept as maybe_.

name: maybe_Field_UpdateEffectColor
signature: void maybe_Field_UpdateEffectColor(Actor* actor, const EffectParams* params)
summary: Attaches or updates the actor's gadget-mesh child: the first call creates the handle with Gfx_Model_AttachGadgetMesh; later calls rewrite the fade floats at +0x5B4..+0x5C4 and push the range to every attached fade handle with Model_Attach_SetFadeRange.
evidence: Both callees are confident, but the RGBA/colour semantics of the four floats is inferred; kept as maybe_.

name: maybe_Ui_SlotTable_SelectEntry
signature: void maybe_Ui_SlotTable_SelectEntry(void* self, int index, float fade)
summary: Selects a slot table entry by index: stores the index, resolves the slot byte, applies colour 0x3DA7C8 and the fade, and re-applies the entry through maybe_Ui_SlotTable_ApplyEntry when the fade is at or below zero; index 0xFF clears the selection.
evidence: Called by the confident Ui_SlotTable_Refresh and Ui_SlotTable_UpdateSelection, but the table class and fade meaning are inferred; kept as maybe_.

name: maybe_Field_CheckGimmickItemGetFlag
summary: The readable C here is a misdecompiled float tail; per the disassembly this is the tail of IsGimmickItemGetTimming (0x0015EBFC): resolves the game-object handle and returns the signed status byte at object+0x2B4, or 1 when the handle does not resolve.
evidence: The body contains irrelevant acos/float code and no named callers; only the asm in asm/text/text_00140048.s supports the role, so it stays at 0.35.

name: maybe_Ui_Widget_SetAlphaFromAnimRecord
summary: Applies the widget animation record's alpha/colour tuple: reads the float at record+0x24 and the byte at record+0x28 (-1.0/0xFF when absent), stores them on the widget, clears the dirty byte at +0x35 and asks vtable +0x2C to rebuild.
evidence: Called by the confident Field_Actor_UpdateMotionScale and Field_Npc_UpdateAnchor, but the 'anim record' field meanings are inferred; kept as maybe_.

name: maybe_Model_Attach_SetSpinRange
signature: void maybe_Model_Attach_SetSpinRange(ModelAttachSlot* slot, s32 start, s32 end)
summary: Configures spin-angle limits in fields f_5C8..f_5D8 of a model attach slot and recursively propagates them to the children in the intrusive list at f_6B4.
evidence: Called from Ui_FaceIcon_CreateWidget; the body has in_s0/in_s1 float-register spillage (FACTS.md), so confidence stays 0.35.

name: maybe_Ui_ListEntryObject_Ctor
summary: Constructor for a 0x30-byte list-entry helper: installs vtable 0x007610B0, stores the owner, sets -1.0f at +0x1C and initialises the embedded sub-object at +4.
evidence: Called only by Ui_ListWindow_InitDataObjects (confident), which supports the list-entry role, but vtable 0x007610B0 is unnamed; kept as maybe_.

name: maybe_Ui_DungeonHpWindow_AnimateRows
signature: void maybe_Ui_DungeonHpWindow_AnimateRows(UiDungeonHpWindow* self, float* target, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5)
summary: Starts the row tween of the dungeon HP window: finds the first row whose comparison values say 'not yet placed', lays the rows out, copies the target into that row's +0x350..+0x358 and kicks the tween through Ui_Tween_SetSpeeds.
evidence: Two named maybe_ callees and no caller; kept as maybe_.

name: maybe_Ui_ChildWindowList_Init
summary: Initialises a small UI child-list object: installs vtable 0x7610B0, clears words 1/2 and 7..11, stores the owner at +0xC, sets -1.0f at +0x1C, initialises the embedded +0x10 block and swaps in vtable 0x76FE10.
evidence: Called by Ui_ListWindow_InitDataObjects; both installed vtables are unnamed; kept as maybe_.

name: maybe_Ui_CompositeWindow_Ctor1
summary: Composite window constructor called from Battle_TextWindow_Ctor: chains six sub-object initialisers and installs vtable 0x0076A078.
evidence: The only caller Battle_TextWindow_Ctor is named, but the class beyond 'composite window' is still unidentified; kept as maybe_.

name: maybe_Ui_SlotTable_AddEntry
signature: void maybe_Ui_SlotTable_AddEntry(void* self, int speakerId, int value, void* slots)
summary: Appends a (speaker, value) pair to the ten 2-byte slots with the 0xFF sentinel; if the id equals the current message character it becomes slot 0x40 and is applied through 0x3DA144.
evidence: The body is damaged (coprocessor_store, in_* registers) and the owner class is inferred; kept at 0.25.

name: maybe_Ui_SlotTable_AddEntryEx
signature: void maybe_Ui_SlotTable_AddEntryEx(void* self, unsigned char id, unsigned char value)

name: maybe_Menu_TalkParty_CreatePanel
signature: void maybe_Menu_TalkParty_CreatePanel(void* self, u32 index, u32 arg3)
summary: Creates (or tears down) one talk-party sub-panel by index: destroys the old slot, then allocates and constructs the concrete class for that index (text, shop, choice, face, casino prize, message select, ...).

summary: Large message/battle-window state machine: scrolls and types the current text line, resets the attached model when the window closes and runs the open/close transitions, with several battle member-display calls interleaved.

name: maybe_Battle_ActorAction_SpawnImpactEffects
summary: Impact branch of a battle actor action: places the hit locator pair, spawns impact effect instances and the damage popup, plays the hit SE and updates the monster size.
evidence: The body's jump table is largely lost (halt_baddata) and there is no caller; kept at 0.30.

evidence: Called by Ui_SmithMenu_RefreshParts, but the body is damaged (unaff_r9, dropped argument registers) and the class is not proven; kept at 0.30.

name: maybe_Gfx_SpriteNode_EmitBurstOnEvent

name: maybe_Battle_TextWindow_UpdateTargetMarker
summary: Per-frame update of a tracked-target label: validates the f_25C handle, reads the target actor's position/rotation, optionally adds the offset matrix and pushes position plus matrix to the text panel; clears the latch and hides the panel when the handle is lost.

signature: void maybe_Battle_ApplyUnitPartMask(BattleUnit* self, u32 maskIn, u32 arg3, u32 flags)
summary: Applies a part/attachment selection to a battle unit: merges the caller mask with the model flag word, probes the primary/secondary attachment tables and forwards the successful transform to the render model, otherwise falls back to the default part update.
evidence: The only caller is maybe_Ui_Overlay_UpdateMarkerTrail and the body has FFFF8000 handle-mask damage; kept at 0.30.

name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_SpawnItemEffect
summary: Effect setup for a field gimmick: resolves an item record through Item_LookupRecord, picks the effect type and spawns the pickup effect through Effect_FindOrCreateInstance.
